notes:
New Features:

- Redlight HD now plays through a lightweight localhost HLS manifest relay. Kodi keeps one stable local URL while Adult TV Test renews the signed .com/Nimble session in the background before its one-hour expiry.
- The relay rewrites media URIs to their real upstream URLs and keeps HLS media-sequence values monotonic across a background session switch, avoiding a visible Kodi player restart.

Improvements:

- Redlight background renewal is scheduled from the signed e= expiry timestamp with an early refresh margin and bounded retry if the website is temporarily unavailable.
- The Settings Release Notes tab now uses a native focusable list instead of ControlTextBox.scroll(), giving keyboard, mouse-wheel and Yatse navigation one consistent scrolling path.
- Future self-updates defer the one-time Release Notes popup to a fresh plugin invocation so the newly installed version renders its own window.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes the remaining Redlight restart every ~60 minutes caused by the chunks.m3u8 child playlist carrying the same expiring signature as the master URL.
- Fixes Release Notes after self-update being rendered by the old in-memory site module rather than the newly installed version.
